Abasement: Lowers the Control Resistance of the target being or beings.
Absorb Aura: The ability to channel the flow of Aura or create an Aura storage device.
Acrobatics: Allows the practitioner to jump, leap, or spring off of a surface in a controlled manner, or perform maneuvers such as flips and cartwheels.
Alter Destiny: Allows the practitioner to use a wish-like power to change the fate or destiny of one individual.
Amplify Item: The ability to supercharge an item’s powers and abilities, albeit at great risk of a magical mishap or destruction of the item.
Animal Lore: Allows the successful practitioner to identify natural animals (living or dead), the habitat the animal can live in, breeding practices, quirks, natural poisons the animal possesses, behavioral traits, and other information that might be useful about the animal. This skill allows for the identification of the following types: Animal, Magical Animal. Creature types are fully explained in the Master’s Manual, Bestiaries like Aspects of the Wild, and Legends of the Unknown of the Unknown.
Animal Projection: Allows the caster to mentally connect her consciousness to that of a natural animal.
Animal Shape: Allows the user to assume the shape of a choosen natural animal (creature type: animal).
Anticipation: Allows the Practitioner to have anticipated the last action of an opponent, and choose a different action in response.
Apathy: Causes the target being, or beings to experience disregard for their current situation.
Apparokinesis: Allows the practitioner to manipulate spatial energies to move objects instantly from one place to another.
Arcane Arrow: The ability to temporarily enchant an arrow with a more potent enchantment. Also, the ability to exercise finer control over a spell that has been previously trapped in an arrow’s aura field.
Arcane Ascendance: Allows one being who has a pact with a powerful spell casting patron to finally understand the powers of the patron, and escape the pact to gain those powers for themselves.
Arcane Pact: Allows one being to make a pact with a patron. The nature of the pact varies depending on conditions the GM determines and may require ritualistic or conditional services from the pact bearer. The pact has to have some form, either a mark or change to the being making the pact, or a physical pact or item held by the patron. The pact grants access to the patron’s magical abilities as shown below. In essence the person making the pact becomes a magic-user who borrows magical ability from the patron.
Arch Ritual: The ability to apply a ritual much more effectively to a population; alternatively, the ability to apply a ritual to a dramatically larger region.
Area Sense: Allows questions to be asked of plant, and animal life in the area.
Armor Knowledge: The ability to move more freely in heavy, or bulky armor, and be less penalized.
Armor Lore: The ability to remove all penalties for wearing heavy, or bulky armor.
Artifact Lore: Represents the practitioner’s ability to recognize an artifact, and information pertaining to it, from fables and legends. This skill is unlike Identify as is not a magic sense.
Artificer Lore: Representing the pinnacle of the enchanter’s art, Artificer Lore builds on previously learned skills to produce enhanced effects with the enchanting process. The Artificer Lore practitioner may also attempt certain related skills due to breadth of knowledge of the enchanting process.
Assassinate: Practitioners of this skill can kill one being in one carefully planned attack
Aura Arrow: The ability to create arrows of pure Aura.
Aura Blast: Allows the practitioner to create a channel of pure destructive Aura Fire.
Aura of Life: Allows the practitioner to temporarily convert some of their life force to Aura.
Aura of Protection: This skill provides the practitioner with several forms of automatic protection against various attacks.
Aurakinesis: Represents the ability to directly manipulate magical energy.
Awaken Forest: The practitioner performs a sweeping ritual and calls out to the forest to rise up and aid the practitioner, usually to drive out some foe.
Awaken Plant: Allows the practitioner to give sapience and mobility to a plant.
Awe: Allows the practitioner to cause other beings to be in awe, forcing them to behave in a subservient manner.
Balance: Allows the successful skill user to balance his center of gravity to walk a tightrope, narrow ledge, etc.
Balanced Mind: The ability to center one's mind, resulting in better concentration for longer periods of time, and improved senses overall.
Ballad Lore: Allows the practitioner to write and learn ballads with various magical effects. The skills Sing and Play are used together to perform a memorized ballad.
Banish: Allows the practitioner to return a supernatural being to its own plane of existence.
Battle Cry: Allows the practitioner to give a war whoop, cry, or scream that unnerves opponents in combat.
Beautify: Causes the practitioner to appear more beautiful, or handsome than they truly are.
Beguile: By means of this skill a practitioner can take control of a humanoid, or magical humanoid.
Bellow: The ability to amplify a target’s voice, allowing it to be heard from farther than normal.
Berserking: Allows the skill practitioner to enter a state of rage with greater physical abilities.
Bestiary Lore: Allows the successful practitioner to identify certain types of creatures (living or dead), the habitat the creature can live in, its breeding practices, quirks, powers or poisons, behavioral traits, and other useful information about the creature.
Bind Control: Allows the practitioner to bind a being or creature they currently control to a repetitive task, or to guard a general area, externalizing control of that being, or creature.
Bind Element: Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled elemental to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the elemental.
Bind Form: Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled physical undead creature (with neither spirit nor soul) to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the undead.
Bind Soul: Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled souled undead to a repetitive task or to guard a general area.
Bind Spirit: Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled spiritual undead creature (without a soul) to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the undead.
Bind Supernatural: Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled supernatural being or creature to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the supernatural being or creature.
Blasphemy: Allows a practitioner to bestow the cursing of an evil-aligned deity upon enemies or an object.
Blend: The ability to camouflage oneself into natural surroundings.
Bless: Allows a practitioner to bestow the blessings of a good-aligned deity upon friends or an object.
Blood Lust: Allows the user to go into a frenzied state well beyond the state of the skill Berserking.
Body Control: Enables the practitioner to enter a meditative trance and then take more direct control of her body and psyche.
Body Parry: Allows the practitioner to use a body area to intercept an incoming thrown or melee weapon.
Bone Lore: The ability to take or give magic powers between magical non-living bone objects, and to magically shape non-living bone.
Brace: Allows the practitioner to steady himself for improved accuracy and damage in combat.
Break Fall: Allows the practitioner to fall in such a way as to avoid or lessen injury.
Cacophony: Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear a horrendous, discordant mixture of bedlam, and noise; the blackest, and most evil sound imaginable.
Call of Air: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Air Elemental from the plane of air.
Call of Aura: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Aura Elemental from the plane of magic.
Call of Death: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Death Elemental from the void.
Call of Earth: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Earth Elemental from the plane of earth.
Call of Flame: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Fire Elemental from the plane of fire.
Call of Life: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Life Elemental from the plane of light.
Call of the Light: The practitioner uses his life force to establish a spiritual portal to higher (and lower) planar realms, sending trapped and lost Spirits and Souls, including ghosts, spiritual, and souled undead, to their intended destinations.
Call of Water: Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Water Elemental from the plane of water.
Call Spirit: The practitioner can attempt to compel all Spirits to come within sensing range of the caster.
Call Undead: Allows the user to create undead beings from the physical remains of the dead or call spirits to rise as undead in an area where one or more deaths have occurred.
Candle Lore: Allows the practitioner to use rituals, candle placement, and color to focus spiritual energy and produce a desired result.
Cartography: Allows an individual to create an accurate, ongoing map of their travels, as well as accurately read existing maps.
Cause Disease: Allows the practitioner to charge their hands with a disease, after which touching a living being, transfers all of the disease to the living being.
Caustokinesis: Represents the ability to manipulate acid, and acidity.
Channel Life Force: Allows the practitioner to temporarily give or take Will Force from willing beings.
Chant: The ability to chant magical rhythms, or to chant beats when combined with Drum.
Charming: The practitioner influence over another’s actions and outlook.
Cheat: The use of this subtle skill allows the practitioner to alter the outcome of a game of chance, either causing themselves or someone else to win or lose.
Chi Sense: The practitioner has a mystical awareness of their surroundings that aids in combat situations.
Climb: Allows the practitioner to scale a variety of surfaces.
Coexist with Undead: Grants the practitioner immunity to all paralysis, hold, sleep and draining effects of undead creatures controlled by the practitioner.
Condition Undead: Allows the practitioner to completely, and irrevocably control a certain number of undead.
Confess: Compels the target being to answer truthfully all questions asked by the practitioner.
Confusion: Causes a target being to be momentarily confused.
Consecutive Normal Punches: The ability to deliver multiple punches in rapid succession but with diminishing returns.
Conspicuous Concealment: Allows the practitioner to stand unseen in plain sight in any environment.
Control Growth: Allows practitioner control of the growth and age of a living plant, either shrinking or expanding its current size.
Control Supernatural: Allows the user to control supernatural beings.
Control Undead: Allows the user to control undead beings.
Convert: The ability to permanently alter another’s perception.
Convert Negative Life Force: Allows the practitioner to convert negative life force into positive life force.
Counter Divinity: The ability to dispel divine magical effects, as well as to disrupt invocations as they’re being invoked.
Counter Magic: The ability to dispel magical effects, as well as to disrupt spells as they’re being cast.
Convince: The ability to temporarily alter another’s perception.
Cover Tracks: Hide, alter, or create tracks in a wilderness environment.
Critical: Allows the skill practitioner to strike an opponent with melee weapon, applying greater than normal force, doing double damage.
Cryokinesis: Represents the ability to control and use cold temperatures in various ways.
Crystal Lore: The ability to take or give powers between magical crystal and ice, and the ability to magically affect crystal, and ice.
Cure Disease: Allows the skill practitioner to eliminate disease in one living being.
Cure Insanity: Allows the skill practitioner to expunge insanity from a being.
Cure Poison: Allows the skill practitioner to eliminate the effects of poison within themselves or another being.
Curse: Allows the user to negatively affect another being who is an enemy of the practitioner.
Danger Knowledge: Allows the sensing of immediate and impending danger.
Darkness: The ability to create a magical sphere of darkness.
Death Visage: Creates the illusion of death around oneself, or others.
Deception: Allows the practitioner to permanently plant a single, simple lie into another’s mind.
Decipher: The ability to discover the meaning of words and symbols in code or a language not normally comprehensible to the skill user.
Defy Divinity: Represents the ability to defy, and strongly resist the effects of divinity through the sheer power of will.
Defy Magic: Represents the ability to defy, and strongly resist the effects of magic through the sheer power of will.
Demysticize: Lowers the Magic Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to magic.
Depth Knowledge: Allows the user to sense approximate current depth from the surface, while underground.
Destiny: The practitioner becomes the master of destiny, altering outcomes wildly.
Destroy Undead: The ability to utterly destroy an undead creature.
Destruction: Allows the skill user to focus strong negative energy on their hands and cause death by touch.
Detect Alignment: The ability to determine a speaker’s alignment.
Detect Aura: Allows the user to ascertain and feel the Aura strength of a person, place or thing.
Detect Curse: The ability to detect active curses, within sight.
Detect Evil: Allows the user to feel the presence of evil beings.
Detect Good: Allows the user to feel the presence of good beings.
Detect Magic: Allows the user to see light surrounding Aura based magic (not divine magic).
Detect Supernatural: Allows the user to feel the presence of supernatural beings.
Detect Trap: The ability to see activation sites for mechanical traps of either an urban or wilderness nature.
Devastation: Allows the practitioner to harness magical energy to unleash a powerful concussive force over a large area.
Devout Supplication: Brings those affected nearer spiritually to the divine, allowing for closer communion between mortals and their gods.
Direction Knowledge: Allows the practitioner to learn in which direction lie north, south, east and west.
Disable: Allows the skill user to incapacitate a target being’s limb.
Disappear: Causes the practitioner to appear to have simply ceased to be.
Disarm: The ability to divest a target of their weapon.
Discord: Causes sounds (including music, speech, and mechanical noise) within earshot of the skill user to sound like discordant, jarring noise.
Disenchant: Represents the ability to permanently remove all magic powers, abilities and effects from a magical item and regain the Will Force used to Enchant or Imbue the item.
Disguise: The ability to appear to be someone or something else other than themselves.
Distance Knowledge: Allows the user to precisely gauge the distance between two objects, or the distance between herself and the object, thus optimizing missile weapon ranges.
Divination: The ability to get an answer from one’s deity (or deity’s minion) about an event or situation that will occur in the future.
Divine Knowledge: Represents a link between the skill practitioner, and a worshiped deity’s hierarchy of minions and supernatural servants. It allows the invoker to pray for new invocations.
Divine Protection: Creates a divine protective shell that absorbs ill effects for the practitioner without them being consciously aware the shield has activated.
Divine Shield: Creates a divine shield that absorbs all divine and physical effects as long as the practitioner takes no hostile actions.
Divine Speaker: The ability to contact and speak to supernatural beings (usually belonging to, but not always, of a deity), and to facilitate an auditory connection if so desired.
Dodge: The ability to maneuver out of the way of a thrown weapon or projectile from a missile weapon.
Draw Power: Allows the practitioner to tap directly into the setting’s purest source of magic and draw it in great volume.
Dream Call: By means of this skill, a practitioner can call an existing dream animal to them within a true dream on the Dream Plane, summon a dream animal to the natural universe for a limited time, or, with great effort, create their own dream animal.
Dream Create: By means of this skill, a practitioner can create or summon a dream object.
Dream Enchant: This skill can be used for a multitude of purposes around imbuing, enchanting, and disenchanting items on the Dream Plane.
Dream Shift: Allows the practitioner to shift from a normal dream to the Dream Plane.
Dream Summon: Allows the practitioner to summon a being to or from the Dream Plane while the practitioner is on any plane of existence.
Drum: The ability to play a magical percussion instrument, and have its desired effect activated. This skill allows for magical beats to be played when combined with Chant (see Percussion Lore).
Echoes of Creation: Allows the skill user to instantaneously create temporary magical items for their own usage.
Electrokinesis: Represents the ability to magically manipulate electricity.
Elemental Arrow: The ability to convert the physical damage of an arrow into elemental energy damage.
Elemental Knowledge: Provides a basic understanding of the underlying relationship between Aura, the physical world, and its elemental energies, and provides the basis for abilities which manipulate that relationship.
Elemental Mastery: Represents a profound understanding of the physical world and its energies.
Elemental Supremacy: The practitioner of this skill is the master of the physical world.
Elixir: The ability to combine magical ingredients (called Hermetics) to produce a liquid or powder containing magical power. The skill also can be used to identify elixirs upon a successful skill roll.
Emanant Peace: Causes an aura of holy peace to emanate from the practitioner.
Empathy: The ability to magically draw another’s hurt into one’s self and cure it.
Empathy Magic: The ability to perform various magics based on empathy.
Empower: The ability to take or give Aura-based magic powers between beings and magical objects.
Enchant Item: Represents the ability to permanently enchant a magical item, similar to the spell enchantment in a faster time with additional benefits.
Enchant Ship: The practitioner’s very presence aboard their vessel causes that vessel to become enchanted.
Enchanting Lore: Represents advanced knowledge of the enchanting process.
Enchanted Voice: The practitioner’s voice becomes a finely tuned magical instrument.
Endow Weapon: Any weapon becomes a magical weapon in the hands of this practitioner.
Energetic Dissolution: Causes the immediate dissolution of subatomic bonds in the area of effect.
Enfeeblement: Lowers the Poison Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to poison.
Enigma: This skill allows the user to craft illusions.
Enthrall: Allows the practitioner to dazzle all beings and creatures who hear her speak and gaze upon her.
Entropy: Causes a decrease in kinetic energy around the practitioner, forcing beings, and objects to move more slowly, or cease motion altogether.
Equalize: Allows the practitioner to equalize physical harm between any two beings.
Eradication: Imbues the weapons of the practitioner, and their allies with the power to eradicate the enemies of their god.
Evoke: The ability to evoke the power of an animal within the practitioner’s own body.
Excommunicate: Allows the practitioner to cut off another from the practitioner’s deity for a length of time.
Exemplar Mounted Archer: Represents an advancement of a mounted archer’s capabilities above and beyond what a mere mortal is normally able to achieve.
Exorcism: The ability to drive out influences, evil or otherwise, within a single individual.
Expulsion: Allows the practitioner to banish all good and evil supernatural in the area of effect.
False Attack: The ability to make a fake attack in an attempt to lure an opponent into parrying, or losing combat time.
Familiar: Causes a familiar of a specific type either named by (or required for) the skill user to come to the caster, and bind to them in such a way as to become more than a pet; essentially a magical companion that provides special benefits as outlined below.
Fate: Gives the practitioner additional ways to use luck to their advantage. Fate expands on the Luck skill and allows wide-ranging usages.
Fear: The ability to cause irrational fear in others.
Fearless: Allows the practitioner to avoid fear and have a greater chance to avoid control while in combat.
Feint: The ability to avoid a melee weapon about to strike the skill user by misdirecting an attacker with body movement.
Fencing: The ability to appraise the value of goods of various kinds, as well as to make the contacts to sell said goods in a particular known area.
Festival Lore: The ability to lead celebrants through the appropriate rituals for a given holiday or significant event. This skill can be considered a sort of magic/divine magic for the masses.
Find Legend: Allows the practitioner to know the location or source of a legend, as well as the general distance and direction, and even the dangers immediately surrounding it.
Find Treasure: Allows the practitioner to concentrate and then sense the direction and distance of the nearest treasure trove.
Finding: Allows the user to concentrate, and sense the direction and distance of a sought person.
Flesh Lore: The ability to give or take magical powers between magical non-living flesh, and to shape non-living flesh.
Flowing Thought: The ability to magically center one’s mind, resulting in better concentration for longer periods of time and an improved connection to mystical and physical energies.
Focused Attack: The ability to maximize melee weapon damage.
Force: The ability to push one’s strength beyond its normal limits to produce almost superhuman results.
Foresee: The ability to see a possible future of oneself.
Foretell: The ability to see a possible future of another.
Forgery: The ability to copy artwork, official papers, signatures, or handwriting.
Future Shadows: Allows the user to concentrate and see future events of importance.
Gaea Lore: Gives the user the ability to sense the state of the biosphere as a whole. It also grants the abilities needed to make sweeping changes to the natural world.
Gate: The ability to create a permanent dimensional gate connecting any two points or connecting a single point to a network of existing gates.
Gateway: The ability to create a permanent gateway connecting any two points or add to an existing network.
Geas: The ability to cause a mental compulsion in a group of beings to complete a set goal.
Glorious Redemption: Allows the soul of a dying or already-deceased being to be redeemed from the darkness to the light.
Glyph: Allows the practitioner to create a powerful type of rune called a glyph.
Gravikinesis: Represents the ability to magically manipulate gravity.
Gullibility: Lowers the Illusion Resistance of the target being, or beings
Gypsy Wagon: Causes a covered wagon to become enchanted, offering a variety of magical abilities to those within.
Harmony: causes dissonant sounds (including music, speech, and mechanical noise) within earshot of the skill user to sound like harmonious and pleasing music.
Haunted Grove: Allows the practitioner to turn a wooded area into a dangerous demesne.
Healing: The divinely granted ability to lay on hands and heal a physical injury.
Herb Lore: The ability to identify an herb’s properties, magical or otherwise. It is also the ability to properly use the herb to produce its effects.
Hermetic Lore: Allows the practitioner to use rituals and magical components (Hermetics) to cast spells.
Heroic Endurance: The ability to center one’s body and accomplish superhuman feats of endurance.
Hex: Allows for the creation, alteration, and removal of very powerful curses known as hexes.
Horsemanship: The ability to handle a trained mount in a precise manner.
Hymn Lore: The ability to write and learn divine hymns of the skill user’s particular deity, the effects of which are generated with the skill Intone.
Identify: The ability to identify the magical powers, abilities or usages on or in a being, area or item. The skill works for items based on Aura and does not extend to divine magic items.
Identify Artifact: Allows the skill user to understand the powers, special abilities and required method of destruction for a specific artifact.
Illusion Knowledge: Provides a basic understanding of how illusions affect one’s mind and how to exploit that relationship for maximum effectiveness.
Illusion Lore: Represents a deep understanding of the effects that illusions may have on the mind.
Imbue: The ability to draw effects from alternative sources not already covered by one of the other material and effect manipulation skills (specifically Metal Lore, Wood Lore, Stone Lore, Crystal Lore, Bone Lore, Flesh Lore and Empower) and to then place or enchant those effects into a magic item.
Imbue Armor: Represents the ability grant temporary magic and enchantments to armor pieces.
Imbue Weapon: Represents the ability grant temporary magic and enchantments to weapons.
Immaculate Grace: Allows the practitioner to intercede with his deity on behalf of another of the deity's followers.
Impart Potential: Allows potential energy to be magically transferred to an object.
Impunity: Magically protects, and can eventually enhance the movement ability of one being.
Incite: allows the practitioner to cause beings to become incensed against a particular being, creature or type of either. The type can be a class, group, race or any way to collectively think of a set of beings, or creatures, or a single identifiable individual.
Inescapable: Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a foe.
Inevitable: Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a target being.
Infinite Jest: Allows the practitioner to confuse, befuddle, anger, and discombobulate all opponents at once.
Influence the Dead: The ability to influence a non-living being’s actions, and outlook.
Infusion: Represents the ability to grant temporary powers to the practitioner’s own physical form for 1-3 hours.
Insanity: The ability to inflict insanity in another.
Intercede: Allows the practitioner to suffer ill effects on behalf of another being as they occur.
Interdict: Temporarily prevents a being from receiving any beneficial divine magical effects.
Interpose: Allows the practitioner to immediately insert themselves between a threat and a being they wish to protect.
Intervene: Allows the practitioner to suffer adverse physical effects in the target’s stead as those effects occur.
Intimidation: The ability to use training, implied threat, and a steady gaze to overwhelm lesser opponents.
Intone: The ability to sing divine hymns.
Intrepid Countenance: The practitioner becomes a vision of holy wrath, beautiful and terrible to behold, awing compatriots, and terrifying those who stand against.
Item Tell: The ability to read an item’s past.
Jewelry Knowledge: The ability to discern type, quality and value of gemstones and precious minerals. Additionally, it provides the ability to correctly cut a gem into its best appearance.
Kinetic Blast: Allows the practitioner to send out a damaging burst of kinetic energy in a desired direction.
Kinetics Knowledge: This skill provides a basic understanding of the underlying relationship between Aura, the physical world, and its energies, and provides the basis for abilities which manipulate that relationship.
Kinetics Lore: Represents a profound understanding of the physical world and its energies.
Kinetics Mastery: A practitioner of this skill is a magical master of the physical world.
Know: Allows the skill user to spend a few moments thinking about a subject and simply know the current information if it is the type of information that would be recorded (history, geography, etc.).
Language Lore: The ability to express ideas and thoughts verbally to a person who does not speak the language(s) of the practitioner, through observation of that language and an understanding of the roots of the languages.
Law: Allows the user to understand and interpret local and regional laws. Also used in a hearing or trial to determine guilt or innocence in the eyes of an authority or jury.
Leap: The ability to extend the distance of a jump through acrobatic techniques.
Legend Lore: The ability to recall the legends of an event, person, or item.
Lethargy: Causes the target being or beings to move slowly due to a sense of weakness, and tiredness.
Levitation: The ability to magically adjust the weight of one’s body and thus cause it to rise or slowly drop.
Lie: The ability to tell falsehood in a believable fashion.
Life Sense: The ability to sense life the way a snake `sees` heat.
Life Strike: Allows the practitioner to turn their life force into a positive destroying force or to imbue positive destroying life force into a single weapon.
Light: Allows the creation of a divine magical sphere of illumination.
Lightfire Knowledge: The ability to learn and cast spells tinged with light energy from the Phase Plane.
Lightfire Lore: The ability to enhance skills, and spells that utilize light, and fire.
Lightfire Mastery: A practitioner of this skill is a master of light, and fire.
Light Step: Allows the practitioner to move from one lit area to another, physically transporting between any two pools of light within visual sight of each other.
Listen: The ability to distinguish sounds that are barely audible.
Living Strike: Allows the skill user to turn life force into a positive damaging force or to imbue positive life force into a single weapon.
Luck: Gives the skill user a luck reservoir and allows them to change the odds in their favor in various ways. Some of these usages require luck skill points to be used.
Luminous Form: Allows the practitioner to change form into pure light, causing flesh and bone to transform into spirit.
Lumokinesis: Represents the ability to magically manipulate light energy.
Magnetokinesis: Represents the ability to magically manipulate magnetic fields.
Malaise: Lowers the Disease Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to disease.
Mark of the Pursuer: Allows the practitioner to always know the location of the target being.  This skill not only provides a distance and direction to the target, but also gives the practitioner knowledge of the target’s exact location.  The practitioner cannot see the target, but rather simply knows where the target is (i.e. the practitioner might use this skill to learn that the target is behind an ale cask and covered in straw in the basement of the Fumbling Foal inn located in the far-away city of Wintersteel which lies 2,479 miles to the southwest of their current location, but they may or may not know of the Fumbling Foal or the city of Wintersteel and does not get a mental image of these places).
Martial Knowledge: The ability to use one’s body as a weapon and for defense.
Martial Lore: The Martial Lore skill user is a master of all martial disciplines.
Mask Life Force: Allows the practitioner to disguise or remove the presence of life force in another, causing it to appear unseen or disguised to skills and effects such as Life Sense or Life Sensing.
Mass Delusion: Causes a group of targeted beings to fleetingly believe whatever the practitioner is saying.
Mass Ritual: : Allows the benefits of a ritual to be granted to the population at large during a significant event; conversely, allows a ritual to be made more powerful due to the participation of the people, again during a significant event.
Massmind: The ability to create a group mind out of willing or conquered sub-minds.
Matter Lore: Allows the practitioner to convert one type of matter into another without the required formula.
Meditate: The ability to settle into a calm state of mind, focusing thoughts and removing anxiety.
Mesmerization: Allows the practitioner to dazzle all beings, and creatures who hear the practitioner speak so that they are immediately affected in various ways unless they are able to resist.
Metal Lore: The ability to take or give magic powers between metal magical objects and the ability to magically shape metal.
Mimic: The ability to mimic another’s voice, or mannerisms, as well as the sounds animals, or objects make.
Mind Blast: Allows the skill user to mentally attack an opponent more effectively and to blast through mental protections.
Mind Dance: The ability to project or read images into and from the mind of another, especially while the focus being is unconscious or in a meditative state.
Mind Link: Allows the skill user to mentally connect to other beings known personally or by name.
Misconception: Causes a target being to momentarily have a false thought.
Missile Lore: Grants expertise in the use of thrown and launched missile weapons.
Mock: Targets a specific individual to achieve a desired result, anger, confusion, inaction, befuddlement, etc.
Move Unheard: The ability to move without making noise.
Move Unseen: The ability to move without being seen.
Multiple Missile Knowledge: Allows the skill user to reduce the penalties for multiple missile fire.
Multiple Missile Lore: Allows the skill user to remove all penalties for multiple missile fire.
Musical Purity: Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear a pure, perfect blending of music more exquisite than any mortal could ever attempt to create.
Narrate: The ability to tell a story so that others are able to witness the events as if they had been there.
Nature Lore: The ability to understand nature’s forces, its ecosystems, weather patterns, migrations, eruptions, etc.
Nature’s Ground: Allows the practitioner to provide many divine protections and effects to a selected area.
Navigate: The ability to chart a course.
Nerve Strike: Allows the skill user to strike a being numb with pain.
Numinous Conviction: The practitioner exudes an aura of holiness, and all those around him feel it in their hearts.
Omen: The ability to call for and interpret divine omens.
Open Locks: The ability to open a lock without its key, without breaking or marring the lock.
Order Knowledge: Gives knowledge of the revealed leaders, history, practices, ceremonies, and services offered by an Order.
Order Lore: Gives knowledge of hidden aspects of an order, specifically unrevealed leaders, history, practices, ceremonies, and special services of the Order.
Order Mastery: Provides various bonuses, information, abilities, etc. for members of a Grand Order.
Percussion Lore: Allows the practitioner to write and learn magical beats with various magical effects. The skills Chant and Drum are used together to perform a memorized beat.
Perfect Shot: Allows the skill user to make the perfect shot, doing double damage.
Phase: The ability to make oneself physically insubstantial in the natural universe by entering the phase plane.
Plague: Allows the skill user to create a permanent disease, and unleash it upon the world.
Planar Lore: This skill represents the knowledge of the planar structure of a setting, and the ability to identify various types of supernatural creatures and servants, as well as the home plane of those supernatural beings.
Plane Shift: The ability to project oneself divine magically, and others into another dimension.
Plane Walk: The ability to project oneself magically, and others into another dimension.
Plant Shape: The ability to assume the form of a plant.
Play: The ability to play a magical instrument and have its desired effects activated. This skill also allows for magical ballads to be played when combined with Sing (see Ballad Lore).
Poem Lore: The ability to write and learn magical poems, whose effects are released with the skill Recite.
Poison Lore: Identification and creation of poisons from recipes.
Possession: The ability to mentally take over another’s mind.
Potion Lore: The ability to create magical and divine magical potions and formulas for potions, and to identify a potion or interpret another’s potion formula.
Predation: Allows the practitioner to mark, and pursue a prey.
Predict: The ability to mentally ask a question about the future and receive a yes or no feeling as a reply.
Prestidigitation: Allows the skill user to move an object instantly from one place to another.
Projectile Knowledge: Allows the skill user to extend the medium range of a particular projectile.
Projectile Lore: Allows the skill user to do extra damage with projectiles.
Protection from Evil: The ability to create an invisible sphere surrounding the practitioner that protects against evil.
Protection from Good: The ability to create an invisible sphere surrounding the practitioner that protects against good.
Protection from Supernatural: The skill user can be protected from supernatural beings.
Psalm Lore: The ability to write, learn, and perform divine psalms dedicated to the skill user’s particular deity with various divine effects. Psalms are combinations of two or more hymns, producing a combined effect. Psalms work in stages, with effects accumulating after the psalmist has spent the appropriate amount of time for each. Thus, if a psalmist combined “Forgiveness” with “Communion”, the effects of “Forgiveness” would occur first (after 15 seconds), and then those of “Communion” (10 seconds later).
Pyrokinesis: Represents the ability to control and use heat and fire in various ways.
Quest: The ability to cause a mental compulsion in a set of beings to complete a set goal.
Quick Load: Allows the skill user to draw two projectiles or missile weapons at once and be holding one while firing or throwing another.
Radiant Life Force: Protects the practitioner’s life force, granting greater resistance to effects caused by undead and complete immunity to undead conversion.
Rain of Missiles: Causes missiles to duplicate and strike multiple targets, or strike a target multiple times.
Raise Undead Horde: Allows the practitioner to target a large number of corpses and/or skeletal remains and raise an undead horde.
Rally: Allows the skill user to rally all friendly troops within sight of the skill user or the skill user’s banners or emblems.
Rally Undead: Allows the practitioner to brandish a symbol or banner, and cause all undead who are controlled by either the practitioner, or an ally to be immune to turning, and banishing of any kind.
Read Dream: Allows the practitioner to enter and read the dreams of another being.
Read Past: The ability to see where a being has been and what happened around them.
Recite: The ability to recite poetry that is magical in nature (created with Poem Lore).
Recover: The ability to restore life and limb to an individual.
Regeneration: The capability of restoring limbs that were lost or rendered useless through damage.
Reincarnation: The ability to redirect the soul of an individual into the body of another being at the time of its birth.
Relentless Pursuit: Allows the practitioner to always know the location of the target being. This skill not only provides a distance and direction to the target, but also gives the practitioner knowledge of the target’s exact location. The practitioner cannot see the target, but rather simply knows where the target is (i.e. the practitioner might use this skill to learn that the target is behind an ale cask and covered in straw in the basement of the Fumbling Foal inn located in the far-away city of Wintersteel which lies 2,479 miles to the southwest of their current location, but they may or may not know of the Fumbling Foal or the city of Wintersteel and does not get a mental image of these places).
Remove Curse: The ability to remove all curse effects from a target.
Remove Fear: The ability to remove all effects of fear in a single being.
Remove Trap: The capacity to remove or disarm existing traps, either of an urban or wilderness nature.
Resplendent Faith: The glory of the practitioner’s deity shines round about them, bathing them in the brilliance of their faith.
Restore Life Force: Allows the practitioner to restore all temporarily missing life force to themselves, or another being.
Resurrection: The ability to restore life to the recently deceased.
Retain Control: Allows the practitioner to continue controlling a target after the normal expiration of whatever effect caused the initial control (such as 1 hour per Practitioner Title through the skill Beguile or 1 minute per Piety Control through the invocation Control Magical Plant), or to prolong the duration a summoned creature must stay with the practitioner (such as 1 day per Aura through the spell Summon or 1 minute per Aura through spells that summon elementals).
Rhythm Lore: The ability to write and learn magical rhythms, the effects of which are generated with the skill Drum or Chant, and to understand the complex rhythms of the natural world.
Rhythmic Mastery: Represents a profound understanding of rhythm, including those of the natural world.
Ritual Lore: Allows the skill practitioner to use rituals to focus spiritual, and magical energy, to produce a called upon result.
Ruins Lore: The ability to gather information from ruined structures.
Rune Lore: The skill practitioner uses magical runes or hieroglyphics to enchant objects and beings with arcane powers.
Sacred Grove: Allows the skill user to take a wooded area and shape it with positive life energy into a peaceful paradise.
Sail: The ability of sailing a vessel with the wind as a source of propulsion.
Schism: By means of this skill a split among believers is created.
Scroll Knowledge: The ability to learn and cast spells with Aura.
Scrying: The capability of magically viewing someone, something or someplace from a separate location by using a reflective surface.
Seal Aura: Temporarily prevents a being from casting spells or maintaining any external magical effects, or prevents a magical item from activating or powering any external effects.
Second Weapon Knowledge: The ability to overcome penalties while using a weapon in the off-hand(s).
Second Weapon Lore: The ability to remove all penalties associated with an off-hand weapon.
Sense Projection: The ability to project the 5 senses away from the body.
Sense Supernatural: Allows the skill user to sense the direction and strength of all nearby supernatural beings.
Serious Punch: A single punch so powerful that it can fell nearly any enemy or destroy nearly any object.
Set Trap: The ability to create hidden traps, either of a wilderness or urban nature, to confuse or harm the unwary.
Sever: The capacity to sever a limb, or the neck with a sharp (cutting) weapon.
Shadow Form: Allows the practitioner to change form into pure shadow, causing flesh and bone to transform into spirit.
Shadowfrost Knowledge: The ability to learn, and cast spells tinged with energy from the Shadow Plane.
Shadowfrost Lore: The ability to enhance skills, and spells that utilize darkness, shadow, and cold.
Shadowfrost Mastery: A practitioner of this skill is the mastery of shadow, and frost.
Shadow Shift: Allows the practitioner to become physically insubstantial and enter the Shadow Plane.
Shadow Walk: Allows the practitioner to move from shadow to shadow, physically transporting between any two shadows within visual sight of each other.
Shadowing: The ability to identify and follow an individual at a distance (within a crowd in urban areas or within brush and foliage in wilderness) without being detected.
Shadows of Heroes Past: Allows the skill user to call forth the greatest known heroes from the past to aid them in one situation or conflict. This effect lasts a maximum of 24 hours.
Shape Shift: Allows the skill user to assume the appearance and size of other beings or creatures.
Shield Knowledge: Allows the skill user to overcome penalties with shields and to use them to much greater effect.
Shield Parry: The ability to block a melee or missile weapon with a shield or buckler.
Shift Time: The ability to send oneself forward in time or view the past.
Sidestep: Allows the skill user to move aside and avoid any and all attacks in a three second period.
Sigil: The divine ability to create runes with blood, or blessed ink.
Sing: The ability to sing magical songs or to sing ballads when combined with Play.
Slay: The capacity to kill a living being with a single blow.
Sleight of Hand: The ability to hide or disguise movement of the hands or objects in the hands.
Slow Fall: Allows the user to reduce or avoid damage from falling.
Smell: The ability of exceptional smell that allows one to distinguish between faint odors. This skill may be used to follow a scent.
Somnolence: Places the target being into a deep slumber.
Song Lore: The ability to write and learn magical songs, the effects of which are generated with the skill Sing.
Sonokinesis: Represents the ability to magically manipulate air pressure, and sonic energy.
Soothe: The ability to magically soothe another being or animal.
Soul Break: Renders a soul unusable, setting it forever adrift in the void.
Soul Knowledge: Represents the ability tap into the past life or lives, and recover buried memories of a previous incarnation.
Soul Rend: Allows the practitioner forcefully rip the target being’s soul from its body, mind, and spirit.
Soul Shackle: Binds a soul to its current plane and prevents it from inhabiting another physical form.
Soul Tap: Allows the practitioner to drain the Will Force of a soul affected by Soul Touch.
Soul Touch: Grants the practitioner direct access to the target being’s soul.
Soulbound Item: The ability to bind a hand-held weapon or piece of defensive gear (typically a shield) or other item to one’s soul, granting the affected items additional properties.
Speaker of the Gods: A much more potent form of Divine Speaker, this skill allows the skill practitioner to directly contact and speak to the most powerful supernatural in the setting.
Speak to Animal: The ability to speak to and understand an animal.
Speak to Dead: The ability to locate and speak to the spirits of the dead.
Speak to Plant: The ability to communicate with a particular plant.
Speak to Stone: The ability to speak to, and understand solid rock.
Spell Arrow: The ability to temporarily enchant an arrow, granting it its own aura field and allowing it to affect targets normally only affected by magical weapons. Also, the ability to trap a spell in the aura field, allowing the arrow to function as a sort of disposable, one-shot magic item.
Spell Lore: The ability to create magical spells, useable with Scroll Knowledge. Also the ability to master existing spells.
Spin Strike: Grants a combatant the ability to spin while holding melee weapons and strike multiple opponents. The practitioner can inflict multiple strikes in mere seconds, including re-attacking the initial opponent after striking another.
Spirit Dance: The ability to call upon the visitation of a group of dead spirits.
Spirit Strike: The practitioner concentrates for one minute, focusing and channelling spiritual energy in order to divinely endow their body.
Spirit Travel: The ability to become insubstantial, leaving one’s body behind and traveling as a spirit.
Spirit Weapon: Allows the skill user to imbue a weapon or set of weapons (including their own natural weapons) with a limited magical enchantment.
Steadfast: Allows the user to avoid certain magical/divine effects.
Steadfast Bulwark: Allows the practitioner to divinely protect another, causing the target being to be the recipient of several beneficial effects.
Steal: The ability to lift purses, sift through pockets, and generally take items carried on another being without being noticed.
Steal Magic: Allows the practitioner to steal a power, spell, or skill that has just been used by another being.
Steal Negative Life Force: Allows the practitioner to touch an undead or negative life force being, and steal its negative life force,
Still Life Force: Allows the practitioner to disguise or remove the presence of their own life force, causing it to appear invisible or altered to skills and effects such as Life Sense, or Life Sensing.
Stone Lore: The ability to take or transfer magic powers between magical stone objects and also to magically shape stone.
Street Knowledge: The ability to identify likely and small-scale illegal operations (and those who perform them) in an urban setting.
Street Lore: The ability to ascertain actual and large-scale illegal operations (and those performing them) in an urban setting.
Stun: The ability to knock someone senseless in a single blow.
Stupor: Causes the target being to feel less intelligent.
Summon: This skill allows the practitioner to summon any object, being or creature from anywhere on any plane.
Summon Animal: The capacity to summon an animal or group of animals.
Summon Object: This skill allows the practitioner to summon one physical object.
Summon Supernatural: The ability to can summon a supernatural being by name.
Suppress Undead Compulsion: The ability to temporarily suppress a compulsion in an undead being.
Surprise Attack: The ability to do double damage with a weapon when striking in surprise.
Susceptibility: Lowers all resistances of the target being or beings.
Sweep: Allows the combatant to consecutively strike multiple opponents, within reach, with a melee weapon.
Sympathize: Removes damage from one being while applying it to another.
Sympathy: The ability to cause an ill effect to be magically passed to another.
Sympathy Magic: The ability to create various magical effects, based on Sympathy.
Synthesize Material: Allows the skill user to create large amounts of temporary magical material, and when used in conjunction with appropriate social skills, create finished magical goods in one step.
Talisman: The capacity to create a special holy symbol with various powers.
Tame Animal: The ability to create a mutual emotional bond with an animal (usually a mammal or bird).
Telekinesis: The capacity to move objects through magic and mental will.
Temporokinesis: Grants the ability to magically manipulate time, which is generally a terrible idea.
Thought Projection: The ability to project one’s thoughts into another sentient being’s mind, and read its thoughts. This also provides the ability to engage in mental combat.
Torpor: Causes the target being or beings to be overcome by a sense of sleepiness.
Totem Call: The ability to call a physical manifestation of the practitioner’s totem to come into being and aid the practitioner.
Track: The ability to identify, and follow tracks, or impressions left by movement across a physical surface.
Tranquil Mind: The ability to create perfect calm in one’s mind.
Tranquility: The ability to create perfect mystical stability within one’s mind.
Transcendent Archery: An advanced form of Zen Archery, Transcendent Archery allows the zen archer to fire through weakness in the target’s defenses, including magical ones.
Transmogrify: Allows the practitioner to take direct control of living, and undead flesh and bone, shaping it, transforming it, or attaching it to other living and undead beings, or parts.
Transmutation: The ability to use a magical process to transform one base material into another base material.
Trap Weapon: The ability to pin an opponent’s weapon, either against a surface, with another weapon, or against one of the practitioner’s limbs.
Trip: The ability to force someone off balance.
True Banish: The ability to banish a being without a true name.
True Dream: Allows the practitioner to create or alter the dreamscape itself while on the Dream Plane.
True Faith: Allows the practitioner to use true faith to their advantage.
True Recovery: The practitioner can bring someone back from the dead.
Truth Tell: The ability to tell when someone is lying or stretching the truth.
Turn of the Tide: The very presence of the practitioner bolsters the courage of all those around.
Turn Undead: The ability to cause undead creatures to flee or be destroyed.
Umbrakinesis: A perversion of Lumokinesis, this skill grants the ability to magically create or alter shadows, and darkness.
Undead Lore: Allows the successful practitioner to identify and distinguish the various types of undead creatures, whether or not they are lesser, greater or arch, and their abilities and powers.
Unification: Allows the practitioner to combine multiple effects of different energy-based skills to create new effects.
Usurp Control: Allows the practitioner to take over an existing control effect of an already controlled being or creature, or to remove the controlling effect from a controlled being or creature.
Valiant Physique: The practitioner gains valiant aspects, making them stronger and causing them to appear more heroic.
Voice of Cacophony: Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear a horrendous, discordant noise uttered by a horde of supernatural beings surrounding the user. The resulting cacophony is worse than the blackest, and most evil sound imaginable.
Voice of Purity: Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear heavenly, exquisite music sung by a host of supernatural beings surrounding the user. The resulting harmony is more perfectly beautiful than any mortal could ever hope to create.
Warp Thought: Allows the practitioner to warp or remove a single thought or memory in a creature or being.
Water Lore: The ability to take or give powers between magical liquids, and the ability to magically affect water.
Weapon Call: The ability to magically mark weapons, and call them back to one’s hand.
Weapon Dance: Represents the ability to juggle two weapons with the same hand and perform two simultaneous attacks.
Weapon Knowledge: The ability to learn and use a weapon and the recognition of the quality of weapons.
Weapon Lore: Grants practitioners of this skill modifiers as melee weapon experts.
Weapon Parry: Allows the practitioner to use a wielded weapon to deflect or block an attack from another melee weapon.
Weather Lore: The ability to predict and modify the weather within their visible range.
Weave Magic: The power to weave magical goods out of the sounds of a song accompanied by an instrument.
Wellspring: Allows the skill user to draw small amounts of Will Force from an extra planar source or the universe at large for enchanting purposes.
Whisper: The ability to diminish a target’s voice, lowering the ability to be heard.
Wild Magic: The ability to create spells on the fly without memorization or study of scrolls.
Will Strike: Allows the skill user to strike an obscenely powerful blow, adding her life essence to the blow to increase its damage.
Winds of Wild Magic: Allows the practitioner to call forth winds that produce random and chaotic effects.
Winged Deliverance: : Causes the target being to be borne aloft on wings of glory and carried to safety.
Withering: The ability to empower the hands with a withering touch which can damage and age any living being touched.
Wood Lore: The ability to transfer magic powers with magical wood objects and to magically shape wood.
Wounding: The ability to lay on hands and cause physical damage.
Zen Archery: The ability to intuitively hit a target with a ranged weapon by negating penalties to hit.
